title: How I met my friend

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for How I met my friend.
Welcome to today's lesson: How I met my friend! Today we will practice how to narrate simple origin stories of friendships.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for How I met my friend:
narrate simple origin stories of friendships; use meeting dialogues in the past

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: friend, met, close, nice, together

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Where did the speaker meet their best friend?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I met my friend at work. We talked about music and now we travel together.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
I met my best friend at school five years ago. We were in the same class and became close.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Tell the story of how you met your closest friend.
